features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 16 Ricoh Gen 6 Dual-Channel Printheads
items.desc: Double the printhead configuration of the FabPro 1i. 16 industrial Ricoh Gen 6 heads in dual-channel arrangement deliver higher throughput without compromising colour consistency or sharpness across the full 1850mm print width.

items.title: Advanced Wrinkle Controller System
items.desc: Built-in precision sensors continuously monitor fabric surface tension and correct irregularities in real time, ensuring smooth, wrinkle-free media conveying throughout every production run.

items.title: Head Crash Protective System
items.desc: Real-time obstruction sensing detects fabric obstacles during carriage movement and instantly protects printheads from contact damage, safeguarding your most valuable components during high-speed operation.

items.title: 5-Stage Belt Squeeze System
items.desc: Water-resistant, 5-stage squeeze mechanism prevents lint and dust from accumulating in the belt system. Engineered specifically for high-lint textile production environments to reduce cleaning frequency and maximise uptime.

items.title: Linear Motor Precision System
items.desc: High-accuracy linear motor drives carriage movement with smooth acceleration and sub-millimetre positioning control, maintaining consistent registration across the full print width even during double-speed production runs.

items.title: Automatic Capping and Wiping System
items.desc: Automated printhead capping and wiping between runs prevents ink from drying on nozzles, maintains consistent ink flow, and extends printhead operational life across long production shifts.

items.title: Customizable Drying System
items.desc: Integrated belt and fins heater with adjustable temperature zones accommodates the full range of fabric types, from lightweight silk and chiffon to heavy upholstery and curtain fabrics, ensuring optimal drying at every weight.

items.title: Efficient Ink Supply System
items.desc: High-capacity ink delivery system maintains a consistent, uninterrupted ink flow to all 16 printheads simultaneously, preventing pressure drops or ink starvation during sustained high-speed production.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Fashion Textile Production
fabrics.desc: High-volume disperse printing on polyester sarees, dress materials, and fashion fabrics for wholesale and export markets demanding fast turnaround on large orders.

fabrics.title: Export Garment Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: Reactive printing on cotton at scale, delivering ISO 4-5 wash fastness required by European and US buyers across continuous high-volume production runs.

fabrics.title: Home Textile Manufacturing
fabrics.desc: Bedding, curtains, cushion covers, and upholstery across cotton and polyester substrates, all handled on a single machine with the capacity to serve multiple buyers simultaneously.

fabrics.title: Jacquard and Textured Fabrics
fabrics.desc: High-resolution pattern printing on complex woven and jacquard structures for fashion and home furnishing applications.

fabrics.title: Silk and Luxury Fabrics (Double-Sided)
fabrics.desc: Precision acid ink printing on silk and premium fabrics for boutique fashion brands, saree manufacturers, and luxury apparel producers.

fabrics.title: Custom and Hi-End Production
fabrics.desc: Export fashion, European and international home textile buyers requiring consistent large-batch quality with tight colour repeatability across orders.

fabrics.title: Job Work and Multi-Buyer Operations
fabrics.desc: Serve multiple brands, exporters, and buyers simultaneously with the speed and capacity to handle diverse fabric types and design volumes without production bottlenecks.
